comparison.objective: Clamp an aluminium bar at its punch mark, drill through it on a press, and retract the drill safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Workpiece stabilization against clamp-pad twist, screw-clamp tightening, drill-feed actuation, and hand clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Bar is clamped, hole is within 5 mm of the mark and through the bar, drill is retracted, and no gripper enters the 5 cm bit zone while spinning; a loose-bar catch fails.
comparison.reason: It shares screw tightening and counterholding, but those actions establish general workholding for drilling; there is no calibrated adjustable setting that must survive jam-nut torque and repeated articulated cycles.
